title: Your Brain Is Wired to Stay Broke — $122K Proof
hook: Scientists proved your brain values $50 today the same as $100 next year — and that hardwired flaw has a six-figure price tag.
angle: Hyperbolic discounting — the specific psychological mechanism behind all impulsive spending — explained with a concrete lifetime cost calculation that makes the abstract feel personal.
audience: 25-45 year olds who know they should save more but can't seem to prioritize the future over the present.
key_numbers: 7x: how much more the brain values immediate vs. future rewards
391%: APR of a payday loan — the purest expression of the 'now premium'
29%: Americans who have a 3-month emergency fund
$122,000: 30-year cost of spending $100/month instead of investing it at 7%
64%: people who'd take $100 now vs $154 in a year in behavioral economics studies
